entities.name: VarRLF-Report
entities.description: UE variable storing radio link failure and handover failure information for reporting purposes.

entities.name: RLF Report Content Determination
entities.description: Procedure where the UE determines and populates the content of VarRLF-Report after detecting radio link failure or handover failure.

entities.name: measResultLastServCell
entities.description: Contains measurement results (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR) for the source PCell (HO failure) or PCell (RLF) collected up to failure detection.

entities.name: measResultNeighCells
entities.description: Contains measurement results for neighboring cells, ordered by best measurement quantities (RSRP/RSRQ/SINR).

entities.name: connectionFailureType
entities.description: Indicates the type of connection failure: 'rlf' for radio link failure or 'hof' for handover failure.

entities.name: VarConditionalReconfig
entities.description: UE variable storing conditional reconfiguration information, including candidate cells for conditional handover.

entities.name: failedPCellId
entities.description: Identifies the failed PCell using global cell identity, tracking area code, or physical cell identity and carrier frequency.

entities.name: previousPCellId
entities.description: Identifies the previous PCell where the last reconfigurationWithSync or MobilityFromNRCommand was received.

entities.name: timeConnFailure
entities.description: Elapsed time since the last relevant reconfiguration message or handover initialization until failure detection.

entities.name: choCandidateCellList
entities.description: List of candidate target cells for conditional handover from VarConditionalReconfig, excluding those in measResultNeighCells.

entities.name: Radio Link Failure Detected
entities.description: Condition where the UE detects radio link failure as described in clause 5.3.10.3.

entities.name: Handover Failure Detected
entities.description: Condition where the UE detects handover failure (reconfiguration with sync failure) as described in clause 5.3.5.8.3.

relations.description: The procedure populates and sets fields in VarRLF-Report based on failure type and available measurements.
VarRLF-Report includes measResultLastServCell to store serving cell measurements at failure detection.
VarRLF-Report includes measResultNeighCells to store neighboring cell measurements ordered by best quality.
VarRLF-Report includes connectionFailureType to indicate whether failure is RLF or HOF.
When RLF is detected, connectionFailureType is set to 'rlf'.
When handover failure is detected, connectionFailureType is set to 'hof'.
VarRLF-Report includes failedPCellId to identify the cell where failure occurred.
VarRLF-Report includes previousPCellId to identify the cell where last reconfiguration was received.
VarRLF-Report includes timeConnFailure to record elapsed time since last reconfiguration/handover start.
VarConditionalReconfig provides candidate cells for choCandidateCellList in VarRLF-Report.
VarRLF-Report includes choCandidateCellList from VarConditionalReconfig at failure time.
